info.title: BOXMEOUT API
info.description:
REST API for the BOXMEOUT decentralized boxing prediction market on Stellar.

B-141 (#1577): all resource paths are served under the versioned /api/v1 prefix. The unversioned /api prefix is still served as a deprecated alias of /api/v1 and responds with `Deprecation: true`, a `Sunset` HTTP-date and a `Link: <...>; rel="successor-version"` header. It is scheduled for removal on the sunset date, so clients must migrate to /api/v1.

AdminKey.name: X-Admin-Key
AdminKey.description: ADMIN_API_KEY — required for /api/admin/* routes and GET /api/oracle/results

WalletSignature.name: x-wallet-signature
WalletSignature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over a server-issued challenge. Also requires x-wallet-address header. Obtain a challenge via GET /api/auth/challenge.

Error.description: Error envelope (#1392). Every non-2xx response from the API uses this shape.

PaginatedMarkets.description: Success envelope for market lists: data plus pagination in meta.

totalVolume.description: Sum of market pools, stroops as a decimal string

totalPaidOut.description: Sum of bet payouts, stroops as a decimal string

get.description: Returns a paginated list of boxing markets.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Only return markets in this category

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: soonest orders by scheduledAt, newest by createdAt, pool by totalPool. Ties break on id.

post.description: Creates a new boxing market record. Caller must prove wallet ownership via the challenge/response flow (see GET /api/auth/challenge).
